$comment: Operator-owned inputs to scripts/build-mas.py, which joins them with the canonical inventory (ksi-signal.json), the boundary classification and the third-party records to produce /.well-known/minimum-assessment-scope.json (MAS-CSO-IIR, MAS-CSO-FLO, MAS-CSO-MDI, MAS-CSO-TPR, FRC-CSX-MAS). The builder fails the deploy when an off-origin host in a CSP is not placed here, when a data store or log in the inventory has no metadata entry, or when a component type is in no KSI evidence domain and has no whole-set reason. AI-drafted 2026-11-05 from the Terraform and the CSPs, for the operator's review.

ochelli.com.out_of_scope: Podcast audio on the activities page (CSP media-src only): the reader's browser streams a public episode directly from the host. Media cannot run code in the page, the host receives nothing from this system, and it is unrelated to the Silk Reeling app or the published evidence, so it neither handles nor affects federal customer data.

traffic.libsyn.com.out_of_scope: Podcast audio redirect host (CSP media-src only), as for ochelli.com: public episode audio streamed directly by the reader's browser; no code, no data from this system.

content.libsyn.com.out_of_scope: Podcast audio file host behind traffic.libsyn.com (CSP media-src only), as for ochelli.com.

aws::object_store::website.holds: Site content and the published /.well-known/ evidence
aws::object_store::website.retention: Current objects kept; replaced versions expire after 90 days

aws::object_store::logs.holds: S3 server access logs for the site bucket (origin reads; flow O), and CloudFront edge access records (flow O2: date, time, edge location, country, method, path, status, bytes and cache result only; no client IP, user agent, referrer, query string or cookie). The deploy role reads the edge records to build the aggregate access summary (flow O3); only monthly counts are published.
aws::object_store::logs.retention: S3 server access logs 400 days; CloudFront edge access records 90 days; then expired

aws::object_store::tfstate.holds: Terraform state: resource configuration and attributes, including secret values
aws::object_store::tfstate.retention: Current state kept; replaced versions expire after 90 days

aws::object_store::recovery_drill.holds: Copies of public site pages for the monthly Chaos Gremlin restore drill (flow J2), deleted, overwritten and restored from versions
aws::object_store::recovery_drill.retention: Every object and version expires after 7 days

aws::kv_table::tflock.holds: Terraform state lock: lock ID, holder and timestamp
aws::kv_table::tflock.retention: Deleted when the lock is released

aws::log_group::silk_reeling.holds: Silk Reeling app Lambda runtime logs: invocations, errors

aws::log_group::silk_apigw.holds: Silk Reeling API access log: request ID, source IP, time, method, route, status, response length

aws::log_group::route53_query_log.holds: Route 53 DNS query logs (created only when DNS query logging is enabled)

aws::message_queue::compliance_dlq.holds: Scheduled events whose emitter invocation failed

aws::identity_provider::silk_reeling.holds: App user records: email address, TOTP enrollment, sign-in events
personal_data: sign-in IP address and device data
aws::identity_provider::silk_reeling.retention: Until the operator deletes the user

aws::notification_topic::evidence_alerts.holds: The operator's email subscription and in-flight alarm notifications
personal_data: operator email address (subscription endpoint, set out of band; never in Terraform or published)

aws::audit_log_trail::management.holds: Management events for the account, delivered to the CloudTrail bucket (flow P)

aws::secrets_manager::*.retention: Until deleted, then a 7 to 30 day recovery window

ext::jsdelivr.holds: Third-party observation: jsDelivr's request logs when a user's browser fetches the MediaPipe runtime
ext::jsdelivr.retention: Set by the third party; not controlled by this provider

ext::google-cloud-storage.holds: Third-party observation: Google's request logs when a user's browser fetches the pose model
ext::google-cloud-storage.retention: Set by the third party; not controlled by this provider

whole_set_types.html_artifact: Static pages are content of the website bucket: the whole-inventory KSIs (PIY) cover them, and every page is sha256-hashed into the inventory so any change is a recorded change.
whole_set_types.kv_table: The state lock table holds lock metadata only; it is covered by the whole-inventory KSIs (PIY) and by the trust-root review of the bootstrap stack.
